_doc: The world's big systems seen on the street map of the town the player stands in (systems/townWorld.js derives what shows from the state; ui/innerMapTownWorld.js draws and walks it). Counts are capped per town size; every pick is a hash, never the shared RNG.

war._doc: billet: soldiers of the realm quartered in town while it is at war (inns, then houses). drill: the hours they drill on the square. musterTents: tents of a host gathering outside the walls. frontHexes: a foe's land this near makes the town a front town; woundedDays: a battle remembered this fresh near it (world/townMarks.js cairn) brings the wounded to the temple. stay.threat: the share kept indoors when a foe's front (a war of crowns fought in KingdomAI's battles: world/kingdomAI.js noteFront) threatens the town. train: the muster's supply wagons (ui/innerMapCarts.js convoys) - a train of `wagons`, `gap` seconds apart, every `every` seconds in town in its hours, each unloading unloadSecs at the camp while `haulers` of the host carry its sacks to the stores. drillBeat: the drill's cycle in seconds - on guard, the thrust on the sergeant's call at `thrust`, recover at `recover`, a step (forward, then back) at `step` for stepLen.

holy._doc: crusaders: men with the cross passing through a town within routeHexes of the muster (more at the muster itself). preachHours: when the preacher calls for the cross in the square while a call is open. surcoat: the crusaders' shirt colour (LPC), cross: the cross drawn on it.

conquered._doc: A town taken from another crown (world/revanche.js kingdom.lostTowns) within days: the new crown's garrison at its gates and seat, and its people grumbling of the old crown.

famine._doc: Famine on the realm or the age's famine over the town's region: beggars at the church and market; a share of stalls bare (where the era has stalls); and in every era a bread line of townsfolk at the bakery's door (else the granary's, the market's, the square's), empty baskets and crates about the square, the granary barred with a guard at its door; `stay` the share of folk kept indoors.

approach._doc: Someone walks up to the player on the street: a messenger with a letter come in the last letterDays, a petitioner when petitions wait and the player holds the town, a beggar in hard times. At most one a day, a hash roll of the day and the town against chance; they wait waitSecs and go.

billet: They say we march within the week.
Ale's thin and the bed's thinner.
Keep your daughters in, mother, we're decent lads.
muster: The host gathers: {foe} will hear of it.
wounded: The surgeon took the leg below the knee.
We held them at the ford. Most of us.
Pray for the lads still out there.
siege: They've ringed the walls with fires.
Keep off the walls: their crossbows reach.
preacher: Take up the cross! {head} calls the faithful against {target}!
Every sin forgiven to the one who takes the vow!
{target} defiles what is holy. Will you stand by?
Come, take the cross, and be counted among the blessed!
inquisitor: The Holy Office sits. Let the faithful speak what they know.
Who among you has heard heresy spoken?
Come forward and confess, and be spared the fire.
grumble_conquered: My brother died at the walls. For what?
They hung {old}'s banner in the midden.
{old} will come back for us. You'll see.
Mind your tongue: the {new} garrison listens.
grumble_famine: No bread at the baker's again.
We boiled the last of the seed corn.
The children cry all night with hunger.
There's grain in the lord's barn, you mark me.
grumble_siege: How long can the walls hold?
I can see their fires from my window.
The well's still sweet, thank God.
grumble_war: They took my son for the levy.
The soldiers drink the tavern dry.
grumble_ban: The temple's shut. No masses, no weddings, no burials.
The Church has cast out {realm}. God help us.
My child goes unbaptised for the crown's sins.
petitioner: {title}, a word, I beg you: will you hear my case?
beggar: Spare a coin, {title}? These are hungry days.
Alms, {title}, for the love of God.
bread_line: I've stood here since before dawn.
Not a loaf left, they say.
Open up! Our children are hungry!
Half a loaf for a day's wage. Robbery.
granary_guard: Stand back! The granary's shut by order.
Lord's orders: not a sack leaves.
teamster: Whoa! Where do you want these?
Bread, salt pork and arrows. Sign for it.
grumble_threat: They say {foe}'s army is three days off.
My cousin fled here from the border. They burn everything.
If {foe} comes, will the walls hold?

looks._doc: LPC layer recipes (assets/lpc/Characters) of the figures that are not the realm's soldiers (those wear the battlefield's looks in the realm's livery: data/military.json battlefield.looks).

liveryColours._doc: The banner colour of a realm's livery (data/military.json battlefield.looks.liveries: the shirt its soldiers wear), so its banners, its soldiers and its battles agree.

drillCalls._doc: The sergeant's calls on the drill's beats (TownWorld.drillBeat).
